responsibility: Contains the grammar specification and embedded semantic actions used to generate pass 0’s syntax-checking parser. This pass performs error-recovering parsing of Modula-2 source while recording only high-level structural information such as modules, procedures, imports, hidden-type markers, and builtin usage through `P0SymBuild`, without constructing full type or code-generation data structures yet.
same_name_distinction: Unlike P0SyntaxCheck.def, which only declares the parser entry point, this .bnf file is the grammar source with embedded semantic actions that generate the pass-0 parser and hook it to P0SymBuild and syntax-error recovery.
